sentences.en: Mandarin is spoken by more people than any other language.
sentences.zh: 普通话被说的人比任何其他语言都多。

sentences.en: Not only can he speak Mandarin, but Shanghainese as well.
sentences.zh: 他不仅能讲普通话，还能讲上海话。

sentences.en: People from Shanghai speak Shanghainese; they can also speak Mandarin.
sentences.zh: 来自上海的人讲上海话；他们也能讲普通话。

senses.zh: （中国）普通话；国语；官话；满清官吏；柑橘
